summary: Create playbook.yaml with a play targeting myhosts that runs ansible.builtin.ping and ansible.builtin.debug msg Hello world, then run it with ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini playbook.yaml.
questions: How do I write a Hello World Ansible playbook?
How do I run a playbook against an inventory file?
What does ansible-playbook output look like?

answer_card.title: Hello World playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: My first play
  hosts: myhosts
  tasks:
    - name: Ping my hosts
      ansible.builtin.ping:
    - name: Print message
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: Hello world
```
Run: `ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini playbook.yaml`
